item.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
item.description: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

item.title: Only Murders in the Building Season 6 trailer goes to London
item.description: 'Only Murders in the Building's Season 6 trailer is here, renamed to 'Only Murders in London' and featuring a stacked European cast.

item.title: États-Unis | Waymo retire ses robotaxis des autoroutes après une suspension en Californie
item.description: Waymo a annoncé mardi retirer ses robotaxis des autoroutes américaines, après des incidents qui ont poussé la Californie à interdire temporairement ses véhicules autonomes sur ses voies à grande vitesse.

item.title: FAA official oversaw router work just before nationwide ground stop, report claims
item.description: The FAA has been quick to point fingers at its contractor over a nationwide ground stop, but it signed off on the work, according to a report.
